  1. Triton and ONNX

Triton and ONNX

NVIDIA Triton Inference Server runs TensorRT, ONNX, PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Python backends, with GPU support and dynamic batching. For CPU-only ONNX, OpenVINO is usually lighter.

Complete values file 

namespace: models

kserve-runtime-configs:
  kserve:
    servingruntime:
      enabled: true
      tritonserver:
        disabled: false
        image: nvcr.io/nvidia/tritonserver
        tag: 23.05-py3

models:
  - name: resnet-triton
    runtime: kserve-tritonserver
    modelFormat: onnx
    storageUri: s3://models/vision/resnet50
    serviceAccountName: s3-sa
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: "4"
        memory: 8Gi
        nvidia.com/gpu: "1"
      limits:
        cpu: "8"
        memory: 16Gi
        nvidia.com/gpu: "1"

Repository layout

Triton expects a model repository, not a bare file:

s3://models/vision/
└── resnet50/
    ├── config.pbtxt
    └── 1/
        └── model.onnx

config.pbtxt:

name: "resnet50"
platform: "onnxruntime_onnx"
max_batch_size: 8
input [
  {
    name: "input"
    data_type: TYPE_FP32
    dims: [ 3, 224, 224 ]
  }
]
output [
  {
    name: "output"
    data_type: TYPE_FP32
    dims: [ 1000 ]
  }
]

Point storageUri at the directory containing the model folder, not at the version directory.

Dynamic batching

Improves throughput for bursty traffic:

dynamic_batching {
  preferred_batch_size: [ 4, 8 ]
  max_queue_delay_microseconds: 10000
}

TensorRT

Fastest on NVIDIA GPUs, but engines are built for a specific GPU and TensorRT version:

name: "resnet50_trt"
platform: "tensorrt_plan"
max_batch_size: 8

models:
  - name: resnet-trt
    runtime: kserve-tritonserver
    modelFormat: tensorrt
    storageUri: s3://models/vision/resnet50_trt
    resources:
      requests:
        nvidia.com/gpu: "1"
      limits:
        nvidia.com/gpu: "1"

CPU-only ONNX

Triton runs ONNX on CPU, but OpenVINO is usually more efficient:

models:
  - name: resnet-openvino
    runtime: kserve-openvino
    modelFormat: onnx
    storageUri: s3://models/vision/resnet50
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: "4"
        memory: 8Gi
      limits:
        cpu: "8"
        memory: 16Gi

Several models on one server

Triton loads every model in the repository:

s3://models/production/
├── resnet50/
│   ├── config.pbtxt
│   └── 1/model.onnx
├── bert_qa/
│   ├── config.pbtxt
│   └── 1/model.onnx
└── yolo/
    ├── config.pbtxt
    └── 1/model.plan

models:
  - name: vision-suite
    runtime: kserve-tritonserver
    modelFormat: onnx
    storageUri: s3://models/production
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: "8"
        memory: 16Gi
        nvidia.com/gpu: "1"
      limits:
        cpu: "16"
        memory: 32Gi
        nvidia.com/gpu: "1"

Address each by name through the V2 protocol.

Calling Triton 

kubectl port-forward -n models svc/resnet-triton-predictor 8080:80

curl -s http://localhost:8080/v2/models/resnet50
curl -s http://localhost:8080/v2/health/ready

curl -s http://localhost:8080/v2/models/resnet50/infer \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "inputs": [
      {
        "name": "input",
        "shape": [1, 3, 224, 224],
        "datatype": "FP32",
        "data": [0.0]
      }
    ]
  }'

Mirroring the image

nvcr.io may be unreachable in restricted clusters:

kserve-runtime-configs:
  kserve:
    servingruntime:
      tritonserver:
        image: registry.example.com/mirror/tritonserver
        tag: 23.05-py3
        imagePullSecrets:
          - name: registry-credentials

Troubleshooting

Symptom Cause Fix
failed to load model Bad repository layout Verify config.pbtxt and the numeric version directory
unsupported platform Wrong platform value Match it to the artifact type
model not found in requests Wrong name in URL Use the name from config.pbtxt
TensorRT engine fails Built for another GPU or version Rebuild on the target GPU
Image pull failure nvcr.io blocked Mirror the image 
kubectl logs -n models -l serving.kserve.io/inferenceservice=resnet-triton -c kserve-container --tail=100
